'''Mothma 5-0''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was in the company of the [[Daring (frigate)|''Daring'']] and [[Bounty (warship)|''Bounty'']] as the ships patrolled the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]].
